name: National Fertilizer Ltd
about: National Fertilizers Limited is engaged in production and marketing of Neem Coated Urea, Bio-Fertilizers (solid & liquid) and other allied Industrial products. It is also engaged in trading of Imported and Domestic Fertilizers, Compost, Seeds and other Agro products. [1]
keyPoints: Market Leadership The company is the largest urea producer amongst CPSEs in India, and the 2nd largest Urea player in India with a 12% share in the country’s total production. [1] [2]
pros: Stock is trading at 1.10 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 24.8%
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 6.54% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 71.6 to 91.8 days.

announcements.text: Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026. 11 Nov

Board Meeting Outcome for Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026 11 Nov - National Fertilizers reported Q2 and H1 FY2026-27 results; consolidated net profit rose to ₹119.50 crore.

Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Regarding Holding Of Meeting Of Board To Consider, Approve And Take On Record Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026. 2 Nov - Board meets on 11 Nov 2026 to approve Q2/H1 FY2026-27 results; trading window closed till 13 Nov 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 30 Oct - T.K. Batra retires 31 Oct 2026; Inderpreet Singh becomes Executive Director from 1 Nov 2026.
